annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block

These meters used for Gas Fuel Control Voltage ( GCE ) Speed 
Vibration

The first draft initiated by eng. Magdy Saad, 
tested by eng Marwa El-Hadidy at 14 July 2005, reviewed by EDEPC Quality Control 
eng. Abd El-Menem El-Emam, accepted by general director eng.Yousry Abd El-Maksuod, 
and approved by eng. Fathy Ragap head sector of Talkha PS.

This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC inspection & quality control 
general director, MPIS coordinator and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & 
quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued, qualified maintenance staff carry the suitable 
 safety ID category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required,

Safety and healthy 
 equipment must be used as safety shoes, safety helmet ..etc
The unit must be shut down.

The recorder
must be out of service.

Disconnect the
power supply of the recorder.
Ensure that the recorder was calibrated in the laboratory.
